cases.case_label: L1 insertion c.3565insL1 in exon 8 of ALMS1
cases.mechanism_detail: A novel LINE-1 insertion in ALMS1 exon 8 (c.3565insL1), in trans with c.11704C>T (p.Arg3902Ter) in two related patients with a milder, later-onset Alström phenotype, is predicted to disrupt the reading frame and truncate the protein.
cases.quote: In this study, LINE-1 insertion occurred within exon 8, which likely disrupted the reading frame.
